title: Comprehensive UI/UX Design System Schema
description: A complete, iteratively expanded schema supporting multimodal color formats, comprehensive sizing units, typographic scales, architectural scales, modern visual states, accessibility standards, multi-sensory tokens, token aliasing, platform targets, RTL/LTR, density modes, component variants and slots, animation keyframes, iconography, imagery, surface semantics, data visualization, container queries, global focus tokens, empty/loading/error states, tooling references, and structured documentation.

TokenReference.description: W3C Design Tokens spec-style alias. Use $value to reference another token by dot-path.

ColorMultiFormat.description: Defines a color in all formats simultaneously, including alpha channels.

MeasurementMultiUnit.description: Supports defining size, spacing, or layout in all available CSS, print, abstract, and scaling units simultaneously.

PlatformOverride.description: Per-platform token value overrides. Allows the same token to resolve differently per platform.

KeyframeStep.description: A single keyframe step in an animation.

offset.description: Percentage position in the animation timeline (0–100)

keyframes.description: Full keyframe definition for complex animations.

FocusRingStyles.description: System-wide focus ring tokens. Apply globally rather than per-component.

highContrastColor.description: Focus ring color in high-contrast mode

insetFallback.description: Use inset outline when offset clips outside overflow:hidden

ComponentStateStyles.description: Styles applied to specific interaction and rendering states.

ComponentSlot.description: A named insertion point in a component's composition model.

accepts.description: Component IDs or categories accepted in this slot

defaultContent.description: Default component ID or description if slot is empty

ComponentVariantAxis.description: A single orthogonal axis of variation (e.g. size, intent, visual style).

tokenOverrides.description: Token dot-path overrides for this variant value

DocumentationNode.description: Structured documentation attached to any token or component.

usage.description: When and how to use this token or component

relatedComponents.description: Component IDs that are related or commonly paired

ToolingReferences.description: Links between the schema and implementation/design tooling.

figmaNodeId.description: Figma node ID for direct deep-link

figmaVariable.description: Maps this token to a Figma variable for bidirectional sync.

codeConnect.description: Figma Code Connect mapping linking design components to code implementations.

propMapping.description: Maps Figma variant properties to React props.

mirrorOnRTL.description: Whether the component layout mirrors in RTL

variants.description: Orthogonal variant axes (size, intent, visual style, etc.).

slots.description: Named composition slots for child components.

children.description: Recursive structure allowing smaller elements to be grouped into larger components.

microcopy.description: Reusable microcopy patterns for consistent UI language.

editPrompt.description: CTA for user to edit AI output

rejectPrompt.description: CTA for user to reject AI suggestion

emptyStateTemplates.description: Copy templates for empty states by context.

bannedWords.description: Words to avoid in UI copy, e.g. ['Orchestrate', 'Empower', 'Elevate', 'Seamless']

tokenOverrides.description: Token dot-path overrides scoped to this theme.

platformTokenOverrides.description: Per-platform token overrides within this theme.

designTokens.description: Three-tier token architecture: primitive → semantic → component. Tokens at each tier may reference tokens from the tier above using TokenReference.$value dot-path syntax.

primitive.description: Tier 1 — raw values with no semantic meaning. e.g. blue.500, space.4, font.weight.700

semantic.description: Tier 2 — intent-based aliases referencing primitives. e.g. color.action.primary → {primitive.colors.blue.500}

dataVisualization.description: Accessible categorical palette — ordered for maximum perceptual distance.

component.description: Tier 3 — component-scoped tokens referencing semantic tokens. e.g. button.background.default → {semantic.colors.action.primary}

focus.description: Global focus ring tokens applied system-wide.

elevation.description: Surface elevation system. Higher levels get progressively lighter tinted backgrounds in dark mode (Material tonal elevation).

tonalOverlay.description: Background tint applied in dark mode for tonal elevation.

surfaces.description: Named surface types defining background treatment, elevation, and allowed techniques per context.

context.description: Which surface context this belongs to

allowedTechniques.description: Visual techniques permitted on this surface type

glass.description: Glass/frosted surface variant definitions. Only used on surfaces where allowedTechniques includes 'glass'.

fallback.description: Styles for browsers without backdrop-filter support

maxPerViewport.description: Performance budget: max glass elements in a single viewport

springs.description: Named spring physics profiles for structural motion. Values are consumed by Framer Motion, React Native Reanimated, or equivalent.

restDelta.description: Minimum distance from target to consider animation complete

staggerChildren.description: Delay in ms between child element animations

once.description: Whether to animate only on first intersection

namedAnimations.description: Named keyframe animations reusable across components.

containerQueryBreakpoints.description: Container query breakpoints — independent of viewport, scoped to container.

flipList.description: Icon names that should be horizontally flipped in RTL layouts

scales.description: Named icon size scales (xs, sm, md, lg, xl).

imagery.description: Tokens for image and media handling.

overlayStyles.description: Overlay treatments applied on top of images.

dataVisualization.description: Chart and graph specific design tokens.

categoricalPalette.description: Ordered accessible color palette for categorical data series.

sequentialPalettes.description: Named sequential color ramps for heatmaps or choropleth.

divergingPalettes.description: Named diverging ramps for above/below-zero or bipolar data.

emptyStates.description: Tokens for empty, loading, and error content states.

maxBodyCharacters.description: Recommended max characters for empty state copy

directionality.description: Global RTL/LTR configuration and mirroring rules.

logicalProperties.description: Whether the system uses CSS logical properties (margin-inline-start vs margin-left)

mirroredTokens.description: Token dot-paths whose values are mirrored in RTL

cozy.description: Slightly reduced from comfortable — common middle ground.
